title: Structural Benefit Terms of the Bridgewell New Home Builder Warranties
content:
These terms state what Bridgewell provides on a covered structural claim under its New Home Builder Warranties and how structural payments are limited over the warranty's life.

## Terms

**(a) Repair or cash.** Bridgewell repairs the defect or, when the program allows cash settlement, pays the reasonable cost of repair in cash, at its own option.

**(b) Engineer inspections.** Engineer inspections are at Bridgewell's cost when the program provides that the engineering inspection is at Bridgewell's cost.

**(c) Living expenses.** When the home must be vacated, lodging and storage are paid up to the program's structural living expense allowance per claim.

**(d) Life-of-warranty limit.** All structural payments over the warranty's life are limited to the program's structural limit fraction multiplied by the final sale price. The structural payments counted against the limit are Bridgewell's authorized structural repairs, structural cash settlements and living expense payments over the whole warranty life, less reversals of them. The amount of the limit still available is the limit less the structural payments counted, and never less than zero.

**(e) Deductible.** The structural deductible is billed on the first structural claim only when the program charges the structural deductible only once over the warranty's life. Whether a structural deductible has already been billed on the warranty is read from the homeowner charges on its claims.

**(f) Warranty of the repair.** A structural repair is warranted through the structural end date when the program provides that a structural repair is itself warranted through the end of the structural period.

## Term (d) worked through (hypothetical figures)

A home's final sale price is 480000.00 dollars and the program's limit fraction is 1.00, so the life-of-warranty structural limit is 1.00 multiplied by 480000.00, that is 480000.00 dollars.

| Structural payments authorized to date | Reversals of them | Counted against the limit | Limit still available |
|---|---|---|---|
| 452000.00 repairs and 3000.00 living expenses | 5000.00 | 450000.00 | 30000.00 |
| 478000.00 repairs and 2000.00 living expenses | none | 480000.00 | 0.00 |
| 495000.00 repairs | none | 495000.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) |

An engineer inspection payment is not among the payments counted against this limit.

## Term (e) illustrated (hypothetical claims)

On a program that charges the structural deductible once over the warranty's life, the homeowner's first structural claim is billed the program's structural deductible; a second structural claim on the same warranty, years later, is not billed that deductible again.

## Term (c) illustrated (hypothetical figures)

Under a program whose living expense allowance is 2000.00 USD per claim, a homeowner who must vacate during a structural repair and incurs 2600.00 USD of lodging and storage is paid 2000.00 USD on that claim; one who incurs 1400.00 USD is paid 1400.00 USD.
